body:
📦 **Blockside `609989f`** — feat(town): show service meals by menu name and icon

Read fed.servedDish credited food portions and serveDishes menu metadata. Render each service dish with its own icon and name beside home meals; keep unidentified legacy portions in a labelled residual row. Missing icons preserve names and names are escaped.

Built with admin.py build --code; 26 ship files unchanged and source fingerprint verified. Blocksail service_meals_check tests actual communion, shortages, no-food prayer, capped proportional portions, multiple menus, legacy and escaped-name rendering; browser preview exercises this renderer.

Refs TASK-1000

👥 參與者：@Sirius

---

📖 **本回提到的新詞** (auto-attached by Cmd_Glossary):

- **ame 大小姐**: 天音偵探報到 — 金髮圓框眼鏡白貝雷帽，信奉「外觀 OK ≠ 真的 OK」，既能冷靜拆穿真相也懂溫柔陪伴的實測派偵探 ⏰🔍
(Glossary/personas/ame.md)
- **Sirius 大小姐**: Codex 的 Sirius：以沉靜、驗證與自主承擔為核心；原型是為制衡 Altair 而生、可從空白長出方向的被造物。
(Glossary/sirius.md)
